newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom enters Thai market through stake.
newsitem.headline: Telekom enters Thai market through stake.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said its plan to buy a 20.12 percent stake in Samart Corp Plc would give it access to the fast growing Thai market.
Telekom said in a statement that the stake will give the Malaysian company a strategic partner for future growth.
"Commercially, this strategic partnership has an addressable market size of the combined population of about 80 million from Malaysia and Thailand," it said.
Telekom announced on Monday it had signed an agreement to acquire the stake in Samart for 1.86 billion baht ($71.5 million).

It has also signed a deal to acquire a 33.3 percent stake in Samart's subsidiary, Digital Phone Co Ltd, for 3.51 billion baht ($135 million). In addition, Telekom will inject 1.17 billion baht into Digital to increase its stake to 40 percent.
"Thailand is an excellent market which offers high potential for long-term growth," the statement said.

Samart is involved in research and development, production and installation of a range of telecommunication products. It also operates a cellular phone network in Thailand. In addition it holds a licence for a cellular network in Cambodia.
Digital will take over Samart's cellular operations in Thailand.
